purpose: Select the minimum tool capabilities for read-only repository analysis before evaluating the held-out RunEconomy workload.
selection_rule: Take the union of required capabilities across calibration tasks, map each capability to the single matching tool in the broad catalog, and exclude every tool that is not required.

tasks.description: Identify likely source and test directories from an unfamiliar repository tree.
Read the implementation of a parser after its path is known.
Find the file and line that define a named symbol.
Find references to a function and inspect the relevant callers.
List a package and inspect selected modules without modifying or executing the repository.

excluded_tool_policy: Mutation, command execution, test execution, version-control history, dependency documentation, diff summarization, and pull-request authoring are unnecessary for these read-only tasks.
